name: Dumbbell Thruster
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand at your shoulders, feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor.
Drive up out of the squat and press the dumbbells overhead in one motion.
Lower the dumbbells back to your shoulders and go into the next squat.
image_prompt_scene: Standing with the dumbbells at the shoulders.
